_comment: Copy to dart_define.json and fill in, then run:
SUPABASE_ANON_KEY is the 'anon public' key from Project Settings -> API.
It is designed to ship in the client: it only grants what the RLS policies
Never put the service_role key here — it bypasses RLS entirely.
_optional_comment: Optional. Without these the MPN lookup falls back to the deterministic
offline catalogue, which is enough to use the app end to end.
